name: Your Neighbor
overview: Scripture reveals that loving your neighbor is inseparably linked to loving God, as Jesus commands us to love our neighbor as ourselves with all our heart, soul, strength, and mind. This love for others is a direct expression of our love for God and obedience to His commandments. God’s own words in Exodus establish the foundation for this relationship, and Jesus emphasizes that keeping His commandments is the proof of our love for Him, which includes how we treat those around us.
